all.name: Rocket Raccoon
all.description: Rocket may not look like a tech genius or an expert tactician, but anyone who's ever made his hit list has quickly regretted underestimating him. This savvy space soldier is equally eager to boost his teammates and to collect bounties on his foes.

item.name: Wild Crawl
item.description: Hold {Jump} to run on a wall.

item.name: Bombard Mode
item.description: Fire energy projectiles that deal damage.

additional_fields.Damage_Falloff: Falloff begins at 10m, decreasing to 40% at 20m

item.name: Repair Mode
item.description: Shoot bouncing spheres to heal allies. Directly hitting an ally provides extra healing.

additional_fields.Casting: Single-cast projectile with delayed impact that also generates a spell field
additional_fields.Special_Effect: One-time healing for allies when projectile hits them，Bouncing Spheres will bounce off surfaces upon contact, with a maximum of 10 bounces. When they approach injured allies, their speed will reduce

additional_fields.Cooldown: 2 charges, with each charge taking 10s to recharge

item.name: B.r.b.
item.description: Deploy a Battle Rebirth Beacon that revives a fallen ally and periodically produces <Orange>armor packs</> and <Orange>rocket jet packs</>.

additional_fields.Cooldown: 40s. You can reclaim the beacon by pressing E. When reclaimed, the cooldown will be reduced based on the beacon's remaining health. If you reclaim a full-health beacon, the minimum cooldown will be 5s
additional_fields.Special_Effect: Generate an item every 3s, including Armor Pack and Rocket Boots

item.name: Web Server
item.description: Rocket Raccoon upgrades his <Orange>B.R.B.</> for Star-Lord and Mister Fantastic. Star-Lord gets an Astral Jump device, allowing him to teleport to its deployment point from anywhere on the map. Mister Fantastic receives a Fantastic Amplifier, removing his <Orange>Elasticity</> limit and letting him actively enter Inflation state.

item.name: C.y.a.
item.description: Deploy a Cosmic Yarn Amplifier that grants allies a <Buff>Damage Boost</>, while continuously providing them with <Buff>Bonus Health</>.

additional_fields.Casting: Targeted ability that, when activated, summons a creature and detects allies within the area.
additional_fields.Special_Effect: During the ability's duration, linked allies will receive an additional 100 Bonus Health points per second, capping at 150. After breaking the link, this bonus starts to falloff after 1 second at a rate of 75 per/s

item.name: Gravity Modification
item.description: Draw in and fling forward <Orange>Chronoviums</> to launch the hit enemy upward.
